Variants.Content: Dorgoil is located on the east bank of the Qohor Forest and the Rhoyne River, and is politically within the woodland trade routes controlled or influenced by the Qohor city-state. It is a castle mainly responsible for local garrison, tax collection and sheltering the nearby population. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.

Entry Dogoio Keep Local families also relied on black goat sacrifices, trees, iron tools, furs, and trade routes through the forest; if any road, well, spring, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Dogoio Keep They will also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the forests of Qohor; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, and true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hooves.

Entry Dogoio Keep If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The traces left by generations of people in Dogoyio Castle are half hidden in the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs and seams left by generations of repairs, and half hidden in the black goats, guild secrets and ancient fears deep in the forest. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Dogoio Keep They care about black goat sacrifices, forests, iron tools, furs, and trade routes through the forest. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see the coat of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
